sources.title: Depth from motion and defocus blur
sources.source_identity: Full original paper uploaded by author; sections2.2,2.3,3.1 and4.2 read. Publisher DOI fetch unavailable; not relying on a review summary.
sources.findings: Known finite exposure, lateral camera speed, focal calibration and estimated blur extent can constrain metric distance. Pinhole special case depth=focal*translation_during_exposure/blur_extent; thin-lens formulation differs. Defocus additionally needs focus/aperture/PSF calibration. Paper test-pattern results are not current robot performance.

sources.title: Isaac Sim motion blur examples
sources.findings: Real-time motion-blur effects have exposureFraction/maxBlurDiameterFraction/numSamples controls; path-tracing exposure uses motion sampling. Latest web docs are contextual, not proof of the installed4.5 runtime setting. Installed SDK/schema inspected separately.

mechanism_contract_not_admitted.input: Current same-eye RGB, causal gyro/encoder camera motion, K; would additionally require documented per-frame shutter response/integration interval and radiometric/optical PSF. For defocus fixed calibrated aperture/focus/PSF and adequate identifiable texture are necessary.
mechanism_contract_not_admitted.RGB_constraint: Known exposure motion predicts range-dependent spatial blur/edge profiles. A measured profile can falsify some distance hypotheses only when latent sharp appearance, occlusion and non-depth blur are identifiable or jointly constrained. Gyro rotation blur alone is not generally metric depth; translational component and actual shutter integration matter.
mechanism_contract_not_admitted.scale: Existing metric motion over actual exposure, focal pixels and optical calibration. Render-frame interval/capture cadence is not shutter duration.
mechanism_contract_not_admitted.difference: Exposure-integrated image formation differs from old between-frame point tracking or per-pixel plane-sweep correspondence; defocus uses lens PSF. Not a new descriptor/model or addition of encoder. No exhaustive historical novelty claim because basic current input prerequisites already fail.
mechanism_contract_not_admitted.possible_implementation_location: A separate same-eye calibrated exposure/PSF forward model and range-hypothesis adapter, only if existing recorded input supports it; no implementation created.
mechanism_contract_not_admitted.coverage_gaps: Textureless/repeated/unknown latent patterns, occluding boundaries, moving objects, mixed motion+defocus+AA and tiny translational blur can remain ambiguous. All original suspended/contact-invisible/boundary targets and per-frame denominators would remain; no current-domain coverage computed.
mechanism_contract_not_admitted.stop: Before any algorithm run, require actual nonzero relevant image formation with calibrated timing/PSF and causal camera-motion synchronization. Do not invent shutter timing, use GT scale or blur arrays synthesized from GT, alter optical/exposure contract, or recollect just to manufacture the measurement.

local_evidence.collector_lines151_169: save_exposure performs eight world.render() calls without advancing physics clock, then stores a single render-time snapshot. This is not evidence of an actual calibrated exposure trajectory integral.
local_evidence.saved_frame_schema: frame_055.npz zip-directory keys only inspected: per-eye render_frame/render_time and source/raw_time fields; no shutter duration, integration weights, fStop, focus-distance or PSF fields. No RGB/depth values loaded/scored.
local_evidence.snapshot_source: Validates frame/time/format/focal/view transform, but no physical shutter interval or blur-PSF qualification.
local_evidence.stage_root_text: No authored fStop/focusDistance/shutter/motionblur/exposureTime fields found in saved root text. This is not a claim that no composed layer or global renderer setting can affect appearance.
local_evidence.installed_USD_schema: fStop=0.0 documented to turn off focusing; focusDistance=0.0, shutter:open=shutter:close=0.0 schema defaults. Schema defaults alone are NOT a runtime measurement or proof every stored pixel has zero blur; renderer postprocessing can differ.
local_evidence.installed_camera_API: set_shutter_properties/get_shutter_properties manage shutter:open/close. Current direct collector does not set or record them.
local_evidence.limitations: No actual blur kernel, focus calibration, image blur strength or camera shutter state was measured. No claim that real hardware lacks these effects; no hardware question asked. Native sensor config remains unchanged.

decision: NO_EXECUTABLE_CALIBRATED_BLUR_DEPTH_CONTRACT_FROM_CURRENT_RECORDS; stop this input-premise branch before implementation. Not a model performance failure, not proof blur methods cannot work.

mechanisms_examined: Calibrated or semi-calibrated near-point-light photometric stereo

primary_sources.title: LED-based Photometric Stereo: Modeling, Calibration and Numerical Solution
primary_sources.authors: Queau, Durix, Wu, Cremers, Lauze, Durou
primary_sources.finding: Independent images under varying known near lights permit jointly constraining albedo/normal/depth through distance-dependent illumination. Unknown spatial albedo cannot simply be ignored when reading brightness as range.

primary_sources.title: Official near_ps implementation README
primary_sources.finding: A still calibrated pinhole camera observes a still scene under8differentnearLEDs; required image stack and source positions. README explicitly says all8lights-on image is not used and JPG visualization images should not be used for PS; ambient image supports subtraction. Semi-calibration estimates light intensities, does not create absent per-light observations.

candidate_contract_not_admitted.inputs: Same-eye RGB under multiple independently identified illumination states, K and metric source geometry plus radiometric model; exposure/BRDF/shadows must satisfy the chosen model.
candidate_contract_not_admitted.constraint_and_scale: Near-light irradiance contains inverse-square attenuation and normal/source geometry. Distinct light-state intensity ratios can remove common albedo and constrain distance; scale comes from calibrated metric light positions, not from an uncalibrated RGB brightness magnitude. Existing encoder/K can transform coordinate frames but does not manufacture illumination diversity.
candidate_contract_not_admitted.difference: Physical intensity response under varied lights is distinct from stereo/temporal feature correspondence or unconstrained RGB-density blending. It is not achieved by substituting a network/descriptor.
candidate_contract_not_admitted.implementation_if_supported: Separate per-eye illumination-conditioned photometric image-formation and source adapter; none implemented. No dataset/GT light/material labels fed into prediction.
candidate_contract_not_admitted.missing_current_input: No separately exposed per-light states or ambient-only/reference stack; current source is a fixed combined illumination profile. Four camera views and RGBchannels are not independent light switches. Camera motion alone does not change incident illumination on a static Lambertian surface when world-fixed lights and scene remain fixed; viewpoint-dependent reflectance adds unknowns rather than supplying the required calibrated stack.
candidate_contract_not_admitted.coverage_and_stop: Unknown albedo/normal/BRDF, cast shadows, saturation, visibility changes and missing light states remain unqualified; all complete target categories/occlusion boundaries would remain in any future gate. Do not vary lights/scene/cameras to make the current-input route work; stop before implementation under the frozen conditions.

local_evidence.lighting_source: install_fixed_camera_fill creates3SphereLights once in world coordinates computed from episode start/goal; each intensity10000 and radius.5. These are extended spherical lights, not the paper point-LED calibration.
local_evidence.runtime_source: SunLightDistantLight intensity1000 plus fixed fill installed at initialization. No per-light acquisition switching in direct collector. The checked source traces fixed-profile authoring; not a calibrated radiometric model of full renderer shadows/interreflections/tonemapping.
local_evidence.saved_root: Contains SunLight intensity1000 and3FixedCameraFill prims intensity10000 each; saved stage identity declares fixed_camera_fill_v1. No light-state image stack in the collector contract.
local_evidence.interpretation_limits: No RGB values, material/albedo labels, depth, geometry scores, light-rank numbers or point-light approximations evaluated. Presence of fixed lights is not proof every pixel follows a simple Lambertian law. No assertion about physical robot lighting beyond supplied inputs.

near_light_followup.decision: NO_EXECUTABLE_NEAR_LIGHT_PHOTOMETRIC_STEREO_CONTRACT_FOR_CURRENT_FIXED_ILLUMINATION_INPUTS; branch stopped before implementation, not a paper performance failure or all-monocular impossibility result.
